Subject: Self-serve signup: Schedule your Redwood demo

Hi Samir,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood — welcome! I saw you started a self-serve trial and wanted to make scheduling a quick product demo easy. You can grab a 30-minute slot that works for you here: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

If you prefer, reply with a few times that work in your timezone and I can book on your behalf. A couple quick things that help our engineers prep:
- Primary use case (chat/search/agents/embeddings)
- Expected concurrent requests or scale (rough estimate)

I attached a one-pager with the demo agenda. If you need something earlier than the calendar shows, reply and I’ll loop in our SEs for an immediate handoff.

Best,
